title: lint-cdc result.json contract
description: Complete contract for asic/<module>/Design/lint-cdc/result.json. On status=pass, stage_specific.violations[] enumerates structured lint/CDC findings (one record per id+rule+severity+reason); pass requires no severity=error entries. Counts and info-severity entries can be derived from violations[] by any reader that needs them. On status=fail, stage_specific.fail_reason is required (if/then below) — the one-line failure narrative. violations[] may still be populated when fail is rule-based but is not required on infra/license/external-reference early-fail paths.

fix_owner.description: On status=fail: the rule that must act, named by this stage from what it read in the raw tool output. Deliberately NOT an enum — the derived input closure in rules.py is the only authority on which names are legal, and decide checks it there. Naming this stage itself (its in-stage remedy is exhausted) or naming nobody both mean a human decides.
